column1: # Product-claim closure ledger. Verified by scripts/check-closures.sh, which
# fails the build if a named test does not exist, skips, or fails.
# claim_id
# landed_commit is INFORMATIONAL. This repo squash-merges (CLAUDE.md: `gh pr
# merge --squash --delete-branch --admin`), so ancestry checks return false for
# every correctly landed PR. Closure is verified by test, never by commit.
# claim_id reuses the BUG-NNN numbering from BUGS.md where the closure traces
# to a testbed bug fix — cross-reference BUGS.md for the full narrative. A
# single bug fix that needs two independent proving tests (e.g. a render-layer
# assertion and the underlying analysis-layer assertion) gets one row per test,
# suffixed by package.
# Seeded from the first eight testbed discoveries in BUGS.md (BUG-001..008).
# Two are deliberately NOT rows here:
#   BUG-003 (macOS `ioreg -l` hang) has a real proving test
#     (TestBatteryCollector_Collect_NoBatteryService, battery_darwin_test.go)
#     but that file is `//go:build darwin`, and this ledger's guard job
#     (ci.yml `closure-guard`) runs on ubuntu-24.04 only — go test would
#     report "no tests to run" there, the exact false-green shape this script
#     exists to catch. Not ledgered until the guard also runs on a macOS
#     runner. The macOS legs of the `test` job still exercise this test on
#     every CI run — just not through this ledger.
#   BUG-004 (efivarfs/pseudo-mount disk false positive) has NO proving test:
#     TestReadMounts/TestReadMounts_FixtureFile only assert generic
#     skipFSTypes membership against tmpfs/sysfs/proc fixture rows — no test
#     fixture anywhere includes an efivarfs mount line, so the fix is
#     unverified by anything that would fail if `skipFSTypes["efivarfs"]`
#     were deleted.
BUG-001
column5: comma-decimal locale must not parse macOS load average as 0

column1: BUG-002
column5: macOS zombie detection must read the stat column, not comm, for process state

column1: BUG-005
column5: hung-process detail (PID/wchan) must be captured at collection time, not re-derived later

column1: BUG-006
column5: ZramUsedPct must be populated, not left at its zero-default

column1: BUG-007
column5: an unprivileged ICMP failure must fall back to TCP, not report the gateway unreachable

column1: BUG-008
column5: AppArmor read EACCES must report "unknown", not "disabled"

column1: # GAP-2 (docs/product-claim-gaps-2026-09-02.md): capture --raw's bundle
# designed for sharing must be sanitized by default.
GAP-2-default
column5: `dsd capture --raw` with no flags touched must sanitize by default

column1: GAP-2-equivalence
column5: a sanitized bundle must replay to the same verdicts as the raw one

column1: GAP-2-json-corruption
column5: a JSON array element whose string value is itself "KEY=SECRET"-shaped must redact without corrupting the document
